subject: Wellington Track and Signal Upgrades
overview: MBTA Capital Transformation staff presented plans for summer 2022 Orange Line infrastructure work, including a 30-day service diversion between Oak Grove and Wellington. Project leaders outlined track and signal replacements, replacement shuttle logistics, noise mitigation plans, and answered public questions.

items.title: Meeting Introduction and Accessibility Guidelines
items.summary: MBTA staff opened the virtual meeting with language translation details, accessibility options, and a safety reminder regarding station ambassadors.

items.title: Capital Transformation Program Overview
items.summary: Desiree Patrice and Steve Moore introduced the Capital Transformation Program and summarized key Orange Line projects, including traction power substation upgrades, digital signaling, and Wellington Yard rehabilitation.

items.title: Wellington Construction and Service Diversion Plan
items.summary: Matt Canova and Ashley Fowle outlined a 30-day Orange Line closure from July 29 to August 28 between Oak Grove and Wellington to replace track, signals, and switches, supported by free shuttle bus service.

items.title: Noise Mitigation and Community Outreach
items.summary: Desiree Patrice detailed measures to limit neighborhood disturbance during 24/7 construction, including a noise hotline, pest control, equipment idling limits, and ongoing public notifications.

items.title: Public Question and Answer Session
items.summary: MBTA representatives answered community inquiries regarding free shuttle bus operations, noise levels, track greasing to reduce screeching, and post-construction service schedules.
